cues.title: The Permian Paradise
cues.text: Two hundred and fifty-two million years ago, before dinosaurs existed, saber-toothed predators and giant synapsids ruled a thriving prehistoric Earth.

cues.title: The Siberian Traps Inferno
cues.text: Until the continental crust ripped open in Siberia, unleashing three million cubic kilometers of molten basalt in an eruption that burned for a million years.

cues.title: Coal Fires & Acid Rain
cues.text: Subterranean magma ignited massive ancient coal seams, pumping billions of tons of toxic sulfur into the skies and unleashing acid rain as caustic as battery acid.

cues.title: The Purple Dying Oceans
cues.text: As superheated seas choked and lost all oxygen, toxic bacteria turned the oceans purple, suffocating ninety-six percent of all marine species.

cues.title: The Fungal Spike & Total Collapse
cues.text: Continents turned into rotting wastelands. Every forest on Earth collapsed, triggering a planetary fungal spike feeding on millions of dead trees.

cues.title: The Lonely Survivor & Dawn of Dinosaurs
cues.text: Against impossible odds, a single burrowing survivor endured underground: Lystrosaurus, clearing the evolutionary stage for the rise of dinosaurs.

cues.title: Resolution: Life Survived
cues.text: Life faced its closest brush with death. Without this catastrophic reset, we would never exist.
